properties.name: v0.18.0
properties.notes:
Cut 2026-07-28. A MINOR bump that locks NOBODY out and rebuilds NOTHING: no node or edge type was added (stamp holds at 28/56) and the dynograph-foundation pin stays at v0.12.0.

THE RELEASE THAT MAKES INSTALL ONCE-PER-MACHINE REAL. v0.17.0's install.sh on main already promised machine-wide registration, but the v0.17.0 assets predate the promise: the kit tarball lacked reflow2_install.py and the binary refused --only-if-present, so the curl install died at its final step on every machine (observed live on the maintainer's own machine, 2026-07-28, and bridged there by a hand-rolled shim). This release is the first whose assets actually carry req:no-setup-per-project: the machine-wide installer, the latent surface (cap:latent-surface -- one tool served where no design exists, nothing created), and /genesis + /adopt as discoverable doors.

Also ships: seam disagreement reporting finished honestly -- seam_report's design parameter now DECLARES it takes an object (BL-28), the defect that held main red between the cuts, fixed with the design gate's own drift catch reconciled two-sided (chg:accept-975fcb51ce6ec113); and Interface.medium no longer defaults to REST, so two silences cannot agree on a protocol neither chose.

Verified by CI run 30371232790 (workspace tests, clippy, fmt, 117 toolsnaps, smoke over real stdio, design gate, doc versions, skill lint) -- this machine holds no Rust toolchain, so the release rides the same runners that build the binaries. Epoch note: v0.17.0 was cut without an epoch or deploy/retire bookkeeping; this cut records its own epoch (sequence 210) and the deploy is recorded separately once the published assets are observed installed.
